caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four horizontal drawers. The dresser is shown in a three-quarter view, with the right side facing forward. The wood is a deep reddish-brown color with a polished appearance. Each of the four drawers features two oval, gold-colored handles, evenly spaced apart, and each drawer is accented with a white triangular keyhole at the center. Decorative lines are painted in a lighter shade on the faces of the drawers, forming oval-like shapes that emphasize the placement of the handles. The corners near the top front are adorned with small gold vertical bands, and the bottom sides have a vine-like gold pattern. The legs are short, bracket-shaped, and match the color of the rest of the furniture. The background is a plain, beige color with no additional objects, and the artist's signature "Stewart" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest of Drawers
